Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1909

Report for the Year 1909 and Budget for the Year 1910
Shanghai Municipal Council, Shanghai, 1910

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the staff list, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statement and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs, the plague and extension maps, the revenue diagram and the electricity charts are not, nor a few one-line cost calculations inside letters. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense and wide pages by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (39 cells). The financial statement and budget have their own page numbers, as printed.
